To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 11B( π−, d t) reaction was studied at TRIUMF, and that the reaction proceeds via a two-particle mechanism.
we have measured a missing mass spectrum of the reaction 11B(p, dt)9Li* and observed a new highly excited state of 9Li at Ex = 12 MeV that decays with the emission of triton.

(i) a new state of 9Li was discovered, (ii) the state was found to have an excitation energy of 12.0 MeV, (iii) the state was observed to decay via the emission of a 4.8 MeV triton, and (iv) the state has spin-parity of 3/2+ and a width of about 0.5MeV.
